tools.title: Word counter
tools.short: Count words, characters and paragraphs as you type.
tools.description: Type or paste your text and BRYME counts words and characters instantly. Great for hitting a target word count before you submit or publish.

tools.title: Character counter
tools.short: Count characters for bios, headlines and limits.
tools.description: Count the exact number of characters in your text — useful for meta descriptions, social bios, and anywhere with a character limit.

tools.title: Character counter (no spaces)
tools.short: Count characters without counting spaces.
tools.description: Count characters with spaces ignored, which is how many platforms count. Useful for strict limits.

tools.title: Sentence counter
tools.short: Count sentences and paragraphs in your text.
tools.description: See how many sentences and paragraphs your text has, so you can spot wall-of-text sections and vary your rhythm.

tools.title: Paragraph counter
tools.short: Count paragraphs and how readable the structure is.
tools.description: Count paragraphs and sentences to check whether your structure is scannable or too dense.

tools.title: Reading time calculator
tools.short: How long a reader takes to finish your piece.
tools.description: Estimate the reading time of your text at a typical pace (200 words per minute), so you can match length to the format.

tools.title: Word density calculator
tools.short: See your most-used content words.
tools.description: Find the words you repeat most, so you can spot overused terms and stale phrasing.

tools.title: Case converter
tools.short: Switch between UPPER, lower, Title, sentence and camelCase.
tools.description: Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case or camelCase in one click.

tools.title: Text cleaner
tools.short: Fix extra spaces, odd line breaks and whitespace.
tools.description: Remove trailing spaces, fix awkward line breaks and tidy messy pasted text.

tools.title: Remove extra spaces
tools.short: Collapse double spaces into single ones.
tools.description: Turn runs of spaces into single spaces and trim blank gaps left by pasting.

tools.title: Line break cleaner
tools.short: Remove stray blank lines and tidy breaks.
tools.description: Clean up inconsistent line breaks from copied text so paragraphs look right.

tools.title: Text sorter
tools.short: Sort a list alphabetically, ascending or descending.
tools.description: Alphabetise a list of lines quickly — useful for bibliographies, references and notes.

tools.title: Duplicate line remover
tools.short: Remove repeated lines from a list.
tools.description: Deduplicate a list of lines so each entry appears once.

tools.title: Writing timer
tools.short: A simple focus timer for your next writing session.
tools.description: A timer to make you write for a focused stretch. Set a goal and let the timer keep you honest.

tools.title: Article outline generator
tools.short: Generate a structure for your next article.
tools.description: Turn a title and a few key points into a ready-to-write outline with a suggested structure.

tools.title: Writing checklist generator
tools.short: Turn checklist items into a tickable box list.
tools.description: Paste items, one per line, and BRYME makes them into a tickable checklist you can work through.

tools.title: Syllable counter
tools.short: Count syllables for readability and rhythm.
tools.description: Count the syllables in your text — useful for readability, poetry rhythm and pacing.

tools.title: Readability score
tools.short: Estimate how easy your text is to read.
tools.description: A Flesch reading-ease score shows how easy your writing is to read, so you can match it to your audience.

tools.title: Filler word finder
tools.short: Find 'very', 'really', 'actually' and wordy phrases.
tools.description: Spot unnecessary intensifiers and wordy phrases so you can cut them and tighten your writing.

tools.title: Passive voice detector
tools.short: Find sentences that hide the doer.
tools.description: Detect possible passive-voice sentences so you can make the doer the subject and write more directly.

tools.title: Word repetition checker
tools.short: Find words you over-use.
tools.description: See which content words repeat the most, so you can vary phrasing and avoid sounding repetitive.

tools.title: Sentence length checker
tools.short: Find sentences that are too long.
tools.description: Identify sentences over 25 words so you can split them and improve readability.

tools.title: Cliché detector
tools.short: Spot tired, over-used phrases.
tools.description: Find common clichés and replace them with fresh, specific language.

tools.title: Adverb finder
tools.short: Find -ly adverbs and weak verbs.
tools.description: List the -ly adverbs in your text so you can swap weak ones for stronger, active verbs.

tools.title: Title / headline generator
tools.short: Get punchy headline ideas for a topic.
tools.description: Generate a bank of specific, actionable headlines and titles for your article, blog post or essay.

tools.title: Meta description generator
tools.short: Draft a 160-character search snippet.
tools.description: Write a clear meta description under the search-result character limit so your page earns the click.

tools.title: Random writing prompt
tools.short: A fresh idea to write from.
tools.description: Get a surprise writing prompt to beat the blank page — great for journaling and creative writing.

tools.title: Word document converter
tools.short: Turn your text into a downloadable Word (.doc) file.
tools.description: Paste or write your text and download it as a Word-compatible .doc document (or a .txt file). No account, no upload — it converts right in your browser.

tools.title: PDF editor
tools.short: Rotate, delete, reorder or merge PDF pages in your browser.
tools.description: Open a PDF and rotate, delete, reorder or merge its pages, then export a new PDF. Fully client-side — nothing is uploaded.
tools.seo_title: PDF editor online — rotate, merge & edit PDFs in your browser | BRYME
tools.seo_desc: Edit a PDF right in your browser: rotate, delete, reorder or merge pages and export a new PDF. Free, private, no upload and no account.

tools.title: PDF to text
tools.short: Extract text from a PDF so you can copy and reuse it.
tools.description: Turn a PDF's text into copyable, editable text. Runs in your browser; useful for reusing the words from a PDF you already have.
tools.seo_title: PDF to text converter — extract text from PDF free | BRYME
tools.seo_desc: Extract the text from any PDF so you can copy and reuse it. Free in-browser PDF to text converter — private, no upload, no account.

tools.title: Text to PDF
tools.short: Turn plain text into a clean, downloadable PDF.
tools.description: Create a clean PDF from your plain text. Great for a first draft or a simple document — all done in your browser.
tools.seo_title: Text to PDF converter — turn text into a PDF free | BRYME
tools.seo_desc: Turn plain text into a clean, downloadable PDF. Free text to PDF converter that runs in your browser — no upload, no account.

tools.title: Images to PDF
tools.short: Turn JPG/PNG images into a single PDF, one per page.
tools.description: Combine one or more JPG or PNG images into a single PDF, each on its own page, right in your browser.
tools.seo_title: Images to PDF converter — JPG/PNG to PDF free | BRYME
tools.seo_desc: Combine JPG or PNG images into a single PDF, one on each page. Free images to PDF converter in your browser — private and no account.

tools.title: Repetition & self-plagiarism checker
tools.short: Find repeated sentences and phrasing within your own text.
tools.description: Check your text for repeated or near-identical sentences within itself. A client-side heuristic for internal duplication, not a web comparison.
tools.seo_title: Repetition & self-plagiarism checker — find repeated phrases | BRYME
tools.seo_desc: Check your writing for repeated or near-identical sentences within itself. A free client-side self-plagiarism and duplication checker.

tools.title: AI-likeness checker
tools.short: A honest, rule-based look at formulaic AI-style phrasing.
tools.description: A rule-based heuristic that flags formulaic phrases and AI-favoured words. Honest by design: it nudges you to sound more natural, it does not pretend to detect AI.
tools.seo_title: AI writing checker — AI-likeness style checker | BRYME
tools.seo_desc: Spot formulaic, AI-favoured phrasing in your text. A free, honest rule-based AI-likeness checker that helps you sound more natural.

tools.title: Tone checker
tools.short: Estimate how formal or casual your writing sounds.
tools.description: Paste your draft and BRYME estimates its formality from surface signals — connectives, contractions, casual words, exclamation marks and sentence length — so you can match the tone to your reader.

tools.title: Citation formatter
tools.short: Build an APA, MLA or Chicago reference from the details.
tools.description: Enter the author, title, year and source and BRYME assembles a reference in APA, MLA or Chicago format for a book, article or web page.

tools.title: Word alternatives
tools.short: Better words for the ones that weaken writing.
tools.description: A curated list of the words that most often flatten a sentence — said, very, good, important, in order to — with stronger alternatives, and honest advice about when to just delete them.
